FN-BYB2A44-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 78
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Economic Development
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/13/2026
Senate Bill 78 as introduced would provide for the continuance of the Board of Examiners of
Assisted Living Administrators until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The
provisions of this bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
